answer: Trinity Hospital Twin City is a small critical access hospital located in Dennison, Ohio, and is approximately 20 minutes away from the next closest institution that provides similar services. We are located in a federally designated Health Professional Shortage Area (HPSA). Despite operating at a loss, Twin City provides over $1.4 million in community benefits including direct financial assistance and unreimbursed Medicaid care. The 340B program is crucial to the health of our community. We use our 340B savings to teach healthy life choices through our Fit for Life Program, which aims to reduce the number of overweight and obese men and women of all ages in Tuscarawas County and the surrounding counties of Carroll, Guernsey, and Harrison. We also provide support for the community through our Diabetes Wellness program. Twin City also provides medication assistance through its contract pharmacy arrangements that allows qualified patients to receive drugs at discounted prices.
